1373867362156429312.a: I wonder if @Tesla or @elonmusk has considered a few off grid adventure destinations. Find scenic places where solar/batteries aren't intrusive. Make circular platform to view the entire solar array on one side & nature/garden (@kimbal?) on the other. Very low cost supercharging.

1373867364392054784.a: Mount the solar panels high enough large animals don't whack their head if they jump. That allows the garden to extend under the panels and provide a different ecosystem from adjacent areas with full sun. Double plus good if its 2-3 levels: below panel view, eye level, horizon.
